channel.title: Xuanming · Blog
channel.description: Business operations, cross-border growth and AI skill packs — field notes from running a 49-store, 9-brand operation.

item.title: Return Rate Is Not an After-Sales Metric: Counting Reverse Logistics into Net Goods Value
item.description: Return rate is not an after-sales metric but a deduction from net goods value. This post breaks returns into five cost blocks — refund, reverse logistics, packaging loss, customer-service labor and resale markdown — then computes the net goods value rate for four home-storage SKUs: the top-selling wall rack has an 18.5% return rate but only a 75.0% net goods value rate, 16.1 points below the folding box. Includes zero-dependency Python, return reason tags and an assortment threshold.

item.title: Ad Creative A/B Testing: Bayesian Decisions on Material Survival
item.description: Ad creative testing should not be a gut call. AI-generated material variants, micro-budget 72-hour rapid tests, CTR decay rate and Bayesian A/B decisions: in 7 days one home-goods line tested 8 material sets; a high-contrast color block won with 3.2% CTR, 4.5 ROAS and 100% posterior win probability, while losers went into a negative-constraint library. Includes zero-dependency reproducible Python code.

item.title: Dynamic Ad Budget Reallocation: Move Money by Marginal ROI
item.description: An ad budget is not a one-time split. Reallocate by marginal ROI: a dynamic budget pool with 40/50/10 weights, 5 misallocation signals, and a reproducible Python simulator — same 50K daily budget, 5 iterations lift weighted mROI from 2.47 to 2.77, adding 14,900 RMB of daily profit.

item.title: Cash Flow Baseline Management: Stress-Test the Multi-Store Matrix Before Scaling
item.description: Profit on paper is not cash in hand. Define the cash flow baseline as monthly rigid costs times safety months, compare sea vs air capital occupation, and stress-test 12 weeks with pandas — delayed logistics and lagged payments turn 7 of 12 weeks red before cash runs out. Full reproducible code included.

item.title: Amazon Ads ACOS Tiers: Turning Daily Bid Adjustments into an AI Skill Pack
item.description: Lower ACOS is not always better. Group SKUs by gross margin into four target ACOS tiers — scale, profit, clearout, defense — with real weekly report data, a reproducible Python script and a SKILL.md template. Daily reviews shrink from an hour to 10 minutes.

item.title: Don't Just Review GMV: A Five-Layer Net Profit Breakdown as an AI Skill
item.description: GMV is an order metric, not cash. A five-layer net profit breakdown — refunds, take rate, logistics, ads, fixed cost — takes 860K GMV down to net profit with reproducible Python and a SKILL.md template. Reviews shrink from half a day to 15 minutes.

item.title: Landing a Personal Blog with an AI Skill Matrix: web-design-skill-matrix Retrospective
item.description: web-design-skill-matrix upgraded to v0.6.4: added the C-009 dark RGB neon template, pairing with C-008 light as a light/dark duo; the 7-segment RGB marquee halved to 5px via the unified --marquee-width variable (bar visible, neon glow effective, clockwise flow confirmed on a 375px viewport); template previews are now protected as a commercial asset and no longer public.
